2608.10483.title: Predicting Space Groups of Double Perovskites by LLM with Dynamic Few-Shot Learning
2608.10483.paper_summary: Double perovskites (DPs) offer broad compositional tunability, but predicting the space groups (SGs) of stable structures remains difficult because available datasets are often strongly imbalanced toward dominant SG classes. We refer to dominant SG classes as major SGs and underrepresented classes as minor SGs. We introduce Dynamic and Diversity-enhanced Few-shot Retrieval and Rule-Guided Inference for Space-Group Prediction (DyRIS), an LLM-agent-based framework that predicts ranked SG candidates from a given DP composition. DyRIS uses diversity-enhanced dynamic few-shot prompting to retrieve relevant in-context examples while limiting the dominance of frequently represented SGs. It further incorporates rule-guided inference based on B/B' cation ordering, quantitative indicators, and major-SG bias control to refine and rank the final Top-3 SG candidates. We evaluate DyRIS on 3,528 thermodynamically filtered DP entries and compare it with composition-based and descriptor-based baselines. At a training-data ratio of 0.5, DyRIS achieves competitive overall accuracy while obtaining the best Overall Top-1 macro-F1 score and the best performance across all Minor-SG metrics. DyRIS improves Minor-SG Top-1 accuracy by 3.26 percentage points relative to CrabNet and achieves higher Minor-SG Top-3 accuracy than the strongest PyCaret-based baseline. Ablation studies show that diversity-enhanced retrieval, quantitative indicators, major-SG bias control, and B/B' ordering information each contribute to prediction performance. Additional experiments show that the final rule-guided inference step is not easily replaced by conventional classifier- or ranker-based models. These findings demonstrate the potential of combining retrieval-based LLM reasoning with crystallographic domain knowledge for SG prediction in imbalanced materials datasets.
2608.10483.paper_summary_zh: 雙鈣鈦礦（DPs）提供了廣泛的組成可調性，但預測穩定結構的空間群（SGs）仍然困難，因為可用數據集通常對主導SG類別存在強烈的不平衡。我們將主導SG類別稱為主要SG，將代表性不足的類別稱為次要SG。我們介紹了動態和多樣性增強的少量檢索及基於規則的推理空間群預測（DyRIS），這是一個基於LLM代理的框架，能夠從給定的DP組成中預測排名的SG候選者。DyRIS使用多樣性增強的動態少量提示來檢索相關的上下文示例，同時限制經常出現的SG的主導地位。它進一步結合了基於B/B'陽離子排序、定量指標和主要SG偏見控制的規則引導推理，以精煉和排名最終的前三名SG候選者。我們在3,528個熱力學過濾的DP條目上評估DyRIS，並將其與基於組成和描述符的基準進行比較。在訓練數據比例為0.5時，DyRIS實現了具有競爭力的整體準確性，同時獲得了最佳的整體Top-1宏觀F1分數和所有次要SG指標中的最佳表現。相較於CrabNet，DyRIS將次要SG的Top-1準確率提高了3.26個百分點，並且在次要SG的Top-3準確率上超過了最強的基於PyCaret的基準。消融研究顯示，多樣性增強的檢索、定量指標、主要SG偏見控制和B/B'排序信息各自對預測性能有所貢獻。額外實驗顯示，最終的基於規則的推理步驟不易被傳統的分類器或排序模型所替代。這些發現展示了將基於檢索的LLM推理與晶體學領域知識相結合在不平衡材料數據集中的SG預測潛力。
